name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA standard terms document allowing two parties to exchange confidential information under agreed protections, exceptions, and return/destruction obligations.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a SaaS/cloud service relationship covering access and use, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard terms for giving an early-access design partner use of a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a product development program.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime and response time targets, service credit remedies, and termination rights for underperformance of a cloud service.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for engaging a services provider under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard terms governing a provider's processing of personal data on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors, international transfers (EEA SCCs/UK Addendum), security incidents, and audits.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premises or installed software, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership arrangement between two companies, covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a time-limited product pilot or evaluation period before a customer commits to a definitive agreement, covering access, restrictions, and limited warranties.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA business associate terms governing a service provider's use, disclosure, and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard terms supplementing a core agreement to govern use of AI/ML features, including input/output rights, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
